I'm a freelance technical writer who specializes in developer documentation. I graduated from West Virginia State University in May 2019 with a Bachelor of Arts in professional writing. After graduating, I took an interest in web development and learned JavaScript, HTML, and CSS independently. From there, I learned the fundamentals of modern web applications, including what APIs are and how to build them. As a result of this, I'm able to take code and translate it into terms that users can understand.

Whether it's in writing or code, I'm more concerned with what something is and if it's communicated clearly than I am with what happens "under the hood." For me, technical writing is the natural intersection of those two things. It's a philosophy that I bring to every one of my projects.

Projects

Bookmark API Documentation

API reference documentation for a social media app that is focused on literature. This piece documents authentication and access for guest users, as well as endpoints for account management, post and comment handling, and messaging between users.

Have a Chat API Documentation

API Reference documentation for a messaging app. This piece documents endpoints for authentication, account management, and messaging between accounts.

Uploading and Storing Multipart/Form-Data using Multer and Cloudinary

A tutorial that provides instructions on how to upload and store images using Multer and Cloudinary. This piece provides clarification on how to handle multipart/form-data, how structure middleware functions to handle images, and how to properly format fetch calls to send images.

BCryptJS Documentation Rewrite

An exercise in rewriting BCryptJS' documentation to make it more readable and developer-friendly. While the original documentation was functional, it lacked context for newer developers. This piece clarifies how BCryptJS works in practice and includes a tutorial on how it can be used with other libraries to improve application security. Original documentation: BCryptJS
